title: Argentinian Beef Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir-fry dish featuring juicy beef and a hint of umami from soy sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced onions and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the cooked beef back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour in the umami soy sauce and Argentinian chimichurri sauce, and stir to coat the beef and vegetables.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with grated ginger if desired.
Optional: Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
